sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Image caption: The Professor builds his army of Suits

Simon Judeau, under the mysterious alias of "the Professor," left the Huntik Foundation in order to find a cure for the Curse of the Legendary Titans and founded the Organization practically overnight in New Years 1959. He began building an army of followers through the use of the Legendary Titan of Mind, Araknos', mind control abilities.

In order to cover up how quickly he built an army of international agents, Judeau also falsified the history of the Organization, so as to make it seem as if the Organization had existed for hundreds of years, corrupting national governments and royal courts before making itself known in April 1959. This was told to every new agent, with none questioning the truth of this story. [The Secret of Two Generations]

The truth about the Organization was discovered by Zhalia Moon after hacking into the Organization's extensive data archive and the Huntik team were able to work out who true identity of the Professor. [The Secret of Two Generations]

After the fall of the Professor, the Organization was taken over and led by Wilder, who always used dirty tricks and hated to get his hands dirty. [Doorway to Huntik]

Grier later took over the Organization by taking Wilder as a hostage on Sutos Island. As Grier believed in order more then dominance and was a very honorable man, it is possible that the current goals of the Organization may have changed. [An Ally from the Organization]

Wilder eventually escaped and set up base beneath Shuri Castle in Japan, and continued to plot with the members of his Organization team. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

sections.heading: Bases
sections.wikitext: Their primary base is Organization Central in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prague Prague, Czech Republic], but [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicago Chicago, United States] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotterdam Rotterdam, Netherlands] are also hotspots for their activity. {{source|The Secret of Two Generations}} They also have branch offices around the world used for their global activates. Known locations include [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Venice Venice, Italy]; [[:Category:London, England|London, England;]] [[:Category:Paris, France|Paris, France]]; [[:Category:Vienna, Austria|Vienna, Austria]]; [[:Category:Velo, Greece|Velo]] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Athens Athens], Greece; [[:Category:Valley of the Kings, Egypt|Valley of the Kings, Egypt]] and [[:Category:Silene, Libya|Silene, Libya]].

sections.heading: Members
sections.wikitext:
<!-- Clean-up needed - This section should describe the basic internal structure of the Organization as well as the general role of Suits and/or Suit teams. -->
[[DeFoe]], [[Grier]], and [[Rassimov]] were once among the Organization's top operatives under the Professor, attacking wherever and whenever the Professor wished. The Organization scientist, [[Klaus]], created the [[Teknonomicon]]. After the Professor's defeat, two top Organization members, [[Stack]] and [[Hoffman]], served Wilder.

A typical Organization operative is underhanded, ruthless, and cruel. They follow orders as long as it's advantageous, but will quickly betray any leader who shows weakness. Organization teams are often held together by a sense of profit and opportunity.

History

Simon Judeau, under the mysterious alias of "the Professor," left the Huntik Foundation in order to find a cure for the Curse of the Legendary Titans and founded the Organization practically overnight in New Years 1959. He began building an army of followers through the use of the Legendary Titan of Mind, Araknos', mind control abilities.

In order to cover up how quickly he built an army of international agents, Judeau also falsified the history of the Organization, so as to make it seem as if the Organization had existed for hundreds of years, corrupting national governments and royal courts before making itself known in April 1959. This was told to every new agent, with none questioning the truth of this story. [The Secret of Two Generations]

The truth about the Organization was discovered by Zhalia Moon after hacking into the Organization's extensive data archive and the Huntik team were able to work out who true identity of the Professor. [The Secret of Two Generations]

Bases

Their primary base is Organization Central in Prague, Czech Republic, but Chicago, United States and Rotterdam, Netherlands are also hotspots for their activity. [The Secret of Two Generations] They also have branch offices around the world used for their global activates. Known locations include Venice, Italy; London, England; Paris, France; Vienna, Austria; Velo and Athens, Greece; Valley of the Kings, Egypt and Silene, Libya.

Members

DeFoe, Grier, and Rassimov were once among the Organization's top operatives under the Professor, attacking wherever and whenever the Professor wished. The Organization scientist, Klaus, created the Teknonomicon. After the Professor's defeat, two top Organization members, Stack and Hoffman, served Wilder.

A typical Organization operative is underhanded, ruthless, and cruel. They follow orders as long as it's advantageous, but will quickly betray any leader who shows weakness. Organization teams are often held together by a sense of profit and opportunity.

Abilities

Most operatives tend to rely on two major Titans, Redcap and Mindrone, though Jokoul, Enforcer, Bonelasher, and Strix are often used by higher-up Suits. The basic spell many Organization operatives rely on most is Augerfrost, whilst also relying on other spells like Touchram, Raypulse, Poisonfang, among several others.

Under the control of Wilder, some suits receive Titans such as Doom Warden and/or Shadow Agent. [Gremlow Infestation!]
